name: Accord Synergy Ltd
about: Incorporated in 2014, Accord Synergy Ltd is in the business of providing telecom related services, and undertakes civil contracts.[1]
keyPoints:
Business Overview:[1]
a) Services:
ASL provides comprehensive support services to high-end
 telecom segments on a subcontracting basis. Its offerings
span the full lifecycle of telecom networks, including:
- Network planning and optimization
- Network rollout
- Managed services
- Manpower solutions

pros: Stock is trading at 0.57 times its book value
cons: The company has delivered a poor sales growth of -16.4% over past five years.
Company has a low return on equity of -2.48% over last 3 years.
